summary: Learn to test, monitor, and improve AI agents with traces, metrics, and experiments. Practical 5-day training for intermediate teams.
lede: AI agent evaluation helps professionals responsible for reliability and observability assess agent behavior in development and production. The course covers building trace-based test sets, applying LLM-as-a-Judge and code-based checks, and comparing performance with measures such as completion and latency. Learners also practice regression testing, interpreting controlled experiments, and setting monitoring thresholds to track agent behavior over time.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who need to evaluate, test, and monitor AI agents in development and production environments. It suits teams responsible for reliability, observability, and iterative improvement of agentic workflows.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of Python, familiarity with basic LLM or AI agent concepts, and comfort reading logs, tables, or dashboards. You do not need advanced machine learning theory, but you should be ready to work with evaluation examples, trace outputs, and structured test results. Familiarity with LangChain, CrewAI, or similar agent frameworks is helpful but not required. Participants should bring a laptop with a modern browser and a local Python environment or access to a notebook workspace. Coding is required for practical exercises at a basic to intermediate level. Advanced concepts such as statistical testing and LLM-as-a-Judge design are taught at an operational application level, with hands-on practice using guided templates and datasets.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
